Since the device fuses determine the Flash partitioning and the user is responsible for ensuring a checksum is located at the end of each section, the user is responsible for enabling / disabling a scan of each possible section in the config file:

div.div: A CRCSCAN of Flash only occurs when in Idle sleep. When a scan is completed, an interrupt occurs to wake up the device. The ISR in the Interrupts Task Manager is responsible for reporting the result of the scan and prevent reporting a false error after an error injection.
